semantics.note: Interop artifacts are evidence inputs and references. They do not create REMORA authority or alter ACCEPT/VERIFY/ABSTAIN/ESCALATE semantics.

rules.DRAFT: package bytes may still change; freeze_record is null
rules.FROZEN: freeze_record names a reachable master revision carrying exactly manifest.package_digest; package files no longer change under this contract id
rules.EXTERNAL_RUN_PENDING: FROZEN, and the final pin has been given to at least one named verifier (pin_confirmed_to)
rules.REPRODUCED: FROZEN, and at least one external run record with implementation_diversity REPRODUCTION or SECOND_IMPLEMENTATION over this package_digest; not independent
rules.EXTERNALLY_VERIFIED: FROZEN, and at least one external run record with independence INDEPENDENT over this package_digest covering every claim

lifecycle_model.note: Author runs never advance the state. A state is derived from records; tests refuse an index whose state exceeds its records.
